hookups.source: recreation.gov 258831 catalog (109 'RV ELECTRIC' sites: 107 at 30/50 A, 2 at 50 A; water and sewer Yes) + facility text '20-, 30-, and 50-amp', read 2026-11-20

values.note: Pull-through sites take up to 45 ft and back-in sites up to 30 ft, tow vehicle included; per-site limits run 26-45 ft on recreation.gov. No tents.

sites.source: NPS data API (112 full-hookup RV sites; rvMaxLength 45) + recreation.gov 258831 facility text ('112 full-hookup pull-through and back-in sites ... maximum total length of 45 feet ... back-in ... 30 feet') and catalog (109 units listed, Max Vehicle Length 26-45), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Coin showers and laundry at the Colter Bay Village launderette, for a fee. No wood fires; gas and charcoal grills only. No generators.

facilities.source: NPS data API amenities + fireStovePolicy; recreation.gov 258831 notices ('Generator use is not permitted at any time', 'Wood fires are not permitted'), read 2026-11-20

season.source: NPS data API operatingHours: 'Winter Closure' 2026-10-10 to 2027-05-04 (2027 closing not yet posted); recreation.gov: 'open from early-May to early-October', 2027 peak rate season 05-01..10-09, read 2026-11-20

booking.source: NPS data API ('All campsites in the Colter Bay RV Park can be reserved'; numberOfSitesFirstComeFirstServe 0; 14-night maximum) + recreation.gov 258831 listing, read 2026-11-20

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258831/rates - Peak Season 2027-05-01..2027-10-09: PeakBack-In 125, PeakPullThrough 130, read 2026-11-20 (the NPS data API still lists $112 / $117)

discounts.source: recreation.gov 258831 overview: 'Please note this is a concession run campground and sites are not eligible for America the Beautiful or Senior Pass discounts.' read 2026-11-20

note: Concession-run full-hookup RV park (Grand Teton Lodge Company) in lodgepole pine at Colter Bay Village, a short walk from Jackson Lake but not on the shore; the large Colter Bay Campground is next door. 30 nights a year across all Grand Teton campgrounds. --Claude
